routes: /settings/security/users (isolated native Settings shell and User Access panel; safe HTTP fixtures, not full App routing)
states: Comparable unchanged, changed and toggled-back role selections at desktop and phone in light/dark Chromium, plus narrow dark WebKit. All 30 captures / 15 pairs were individually opened with native view_image after dialog animation settled.

Full saved principal, each namesake role ID and description, saved-permission badges/qualifier, kept unlisted role ID and Close/Cancel/Save remain in place. Only unchanged or reverted Save Changes becomes disabled; a real changed selection remains enabled.

Real SettingsPageShell, UserAssignmentsPanel, UserAssignmentsDialog, state owner, capability store, RBACAPI and API client consume synthetic local HTTP. No live authorization, IdP, original-client, installed or released recovery established.
interactions: Native button activation on unchanged and reverted selections dispatches one PUT per before case and zero per after case across five browser/viewport/theme groups; no automatic writes.

Changed selection dispatches exactly one org/token/CSRF-bound PUT, preserves the unlisted saved ID and suppresses another activation while pending. Successful readback reopens unchanged with Save disabled. Explicitly clearing the last known role sends roleIds: [].
Checked title, identity, both role controls and action containment, no horizontal overflow or page exception. Playwright 1.56.1 matches the integration lock; Chromium 141.0.7390.37 and WebKit 26.0.
